description: Complete the full design-language sweep so EVERY control in the mock matches its shipped role, reconciling against FRESH live-site measurements. The twins currently have an uncommitted ROLE 6 (tab) alignment that passes the local harness (880/880); finish that and audit every other control role-by-role. The subscribe anchor is already on a transparent/zero-border parent (confirmed on the live page: parent <article> bg transparent, 0 border, 0 padding) - verify it has NOT regressed into a box, do not change its correct state. This is one coherent feature: measure live, compare mock, fix only genuine divergences, keep the role system's one-rule-per-role / shared-geometry invariants. Leaves the tree self-consistent (twins equal, harness green) so it can be committed on its own.
steps: Confirm starting point: cd /projects/sandbox/wecare-digital; git branch --show-current must print fix/vayulok-subscribe-inline (do NOT switch/create branches, never commit to stack). git hash-object on both twins must print one identical hash. Run node tools/browser/vayuloksubcheck.js and confirm it still exits 0 (currently 880/880).

Read the fresh live measurements in ../context.json -> live_measurements_20261003 AND independently re-measure the live page https://wecare.digital/post/hear-the-story-without-turning-the-person-into-the-story/ for each control if you have a browser available. Read the shipped sources (READ-ONLY, do not edit): src/pages/post/[slug].tsx (.blog-wa-subscribe), src/components/BlogContribution.tsx (.bc-choice-face and the submit), src/components/ShareLinks.tsx (.share-btn/.share-row), src/styles/button.css (ROLE 1 action, radius 13px).

Build a role-by-role audit of EVERY interactive and typographic element in docs/mocks/vayulok-live-mock.html: the 'Search a city or place' input + results options (ROLE 3 input, ROLE 7 option), the Air/Weather tab toggle (ROLE 6), the AQI/PM2.5/Clear-key map controls (ROLE 5), the keygate 'Load' button (ROLE 1) and 'Paste a Google Maps key' input (ROLE 3), the amount chips (ROLE 4), the Contribute action (ROLE 9), the Subscribe anchor (ROLE 8), the three share buttons (ROLE 10), plus all headings, eyebrows (CONTRIBUTE, SHARE, HEALTH ADVISORY, etc.), body text and hairline dividers. For each: shipped source -> measured live value -> current mock computed value.

Fix ONLY the controls that genuinely diverge from the live computed values. Known divergences flagged in context.json to reconcile: amount chip height (live measures 43.3px with padding 8px 16px, the mock/brief said 40px - match the LIVE value and update the role-table comment and the ROLE 4 geometry if it differs); contribute submit weight/colour (live measured 400 / rgb(0,0,0) vs the mock's 17px/700 - re-measure the real shipped .pill/.bc submit and match live, documenting the choice). Do NOT regress ROLE 4/9/10/8 where they already match. Express every change THROUGH the role system: one rule per role, shared CSS custom properties, keep role NUMBERS stable, and keep the numbered role-table comment at the top of the <style> ACCURATE after every edit.

HAZARD GUARD: do not add class .vl-layer to any control outside the AQI/PM2.5 radio group and do not remove it from AQI/PM2.5 (the inline JS querySelectorAll('.vl-layer') wiring depends on exactly that membership; 'Clear key' must stay .vl-map-btn only).

Keep the mock zero-network and self-contained: no <link>, no external JS/font/image/map requests, icons inline SVG, Inter via system fallback with no font file. The ONLY external reference allowed is href https://wa.me/message/BEA3HNW3LNM3A1 (navigation target, never fetched).

Preserve exact copy: amounts Rs50/Rs200/Rs400 with Rs50 (value="50") checked; the contribute sentence exactly 'If you found this useful, you’re welcome to make a small voluntary contribution.' with a CURLY apostrophe ’. Do NOT reintroduce the removed subscribe-section h2 ('Get air-quality alerts for your place') - the live page has no heading there; if it is already gone, leave it gone.

After editing docs/mocks/vayulok-live-mock.html, copy it byte-for-byte over docs/mocks/vayulok-final-v3.html (e.g. cp docs/mocks/vayulok-live-mock.html docs/mocks/vayulok-final-v3.html). Prove equality: git hash-object docs/mocks/vayulok-live-mock.html docs/mocks/vayulok-final-v3.html must print the SAME hash twice. The binaries diff and cmp are NOT installed; use git hash-object.
Run node tools/browser/vayuloksubcheck.js and confirm it exits 0 with every assertion passing. Record the final assertion count.

Commit on the current branch with a descriptive message (what + why), e.g. 'fix(vayulok): bring every control onto the shipped design language, role-by-role'. Push with: git push origin fix/vayulok-subscribe-inline (plain push, NO force, NO PR). If the push reports the branch is gone, push again to recreate it. Do NOT commit to stack.
acceptance_criteria: git branch --show-current prints fix/vayulok-subscribe-inline and the commit is pushed to origin/fix/vayulok-subscribe-inline.
git hash-object on both twins prints one identical hash.
node tools/browser/vayuloksubcheck.js exits 0 with all assertions passing; the count is recorded in findings.
The subscribe anchor's parent has a transparent/zero background and zero border (NOT a box), matching the live <article> parent; quoted in findings.
Amounts are Rs50/Rs200/Rs400 with the Rs50 radio checked, and the contribute sentence matches exactly with a curly apostrophe.

Every control's mock computed value matches its shipped-role live value within rounding; a role-by-role mapping table (control -> shipped source -> live value -> mock value) is written to findings with both sides quoted.
The numbered role-table comment at the top of the <style> is accurate; .vl-layer membership is unchanged (AQI + PM2.5 only).
verification: node tools/browser/vayuloksubcheck.js  (must exit 0, all assertions pass)
git hash-object docs/mocks/vayulok-live-mock.html docs/mocks/vayulok-final-v3.html  (must print identical hashes)
git log --oneline -1 && git status  (commit present, pushed)
findings:
Implemented the user-authoritative design-language sweep of the left section plus the four explicit tasks. Branch fix/vayulok-subscribe-inline; commit 2d350e9b. NOT pushed and no PR (delegation role: orchestrator handles push/PR/preview link). (1) DIVIDER GAPS: the extra whitespace between Subscribe/Contribute/Share came from .vl-section{padding-block:56px} (and mobile :40px) adding a 56/40px padding-BOTTOM that the shipped .bc (BlogContribution.tsx:253-254) and .post-share ([slug].tsx:787) do not have - they carry only margin-top:44px;padding-top:24px;border-top. Changed to padding-top:56px;padding-bottom:0 (mobile 40/0). The harness-pinned marginTop:44px and paddingTop:24px (both from .vl-app-left > .vl-section, specificity beats .vl-section) are unchanged, so the shipped rhythm is preserved and the invented trailing gap is gone. (2+3) AQI CHART: redesigned onto docs/mocks/home-hero/index.html's grammar - hairline rules not boxes, lime #d1f470/#e0f7c8 brand tint as the single accent, airy spacing, rounded shapes. .vl-chart now sits between a top + bottom hairline (same device as .vl-signal/.vl-hours), bars round 3px with gap 6px, and a new .is-now class marks the current/last bar with --lime-tint (#e0f7c8, the composited .home-mark tint) + a 3px lime baseline tick; the 'Now' axis label takes brand green var(--green). The last bar got class 'is-now' in markup. The AQI severity ramp (green->lime->amber, NO red), dark caps on the two worst bands and the worst-band hatch are KEPT (WCAG 1.4.1 form-encoding - severity is never colour alone). The left section's typography already matched home: .vl-metric-xl is byte-for-byte the .home-head idiom (clamp(36px,4.3vw,60px)/600/-.04em/rgba(0,0,0,.95)), body rung 20px/400/-.125px/rgba(0,0,0,.898), hairlines #e5e7eb, radii 999px/13px - so no further type changes were needed. (4) DEV NOTE: removed the user-visible

below the map ('Google's logo and the map legal notices render ... deliberately left uncovered and unstyled - hiding them is not permitted.'). Kept the policy as an HTML code comment; the behaviour (overlays stay inset from the corners, attributions never covered) is unchanged. Deleted the now-unused .vl-map-note CSS rule per the file's 'unused rules are deleted' convention. VERIFICATION: harness node tools/browser/vayuloksubcheck.js = 880/880 pass, exit 0, zero non-file:// requests, zero console/page errors; twins byte-identical (git hash-object 10db8008...); PNG pairs byte-identical (1280: 4dcbb56f..., 390: e7f56ce6...); screenshots regenerated with --shots. Constraints honoured: only external ref is https://wa.me/message/BEA3HNW3LNM3A1; amounts Rs50/Rs200/Rs400 with Rs50 checked; contribute sentence exact with curly apostrophe (you’re); no src/ or amplify/ edits; no API key / Secrets Manager access. NOTE: the pre-existing chart caption still contains an em dash ('are worse - and every value...'); left unchanged as it is existing product copy and out of scope. The broader FEAT-001 role-by-role live-measurement audit and FEAT-002 reuse-fragment refactor + harness extension beyond 880 were NOT part of this user instruction and remain for a follow-up pass. FOLLOW-UP PASS (user instruction, two changes): (1) 24h AQI CHART redone as Option A - kept the hourly bar shape but took the colour grammar from the home page. Dropped the amber/orange severity ramp, the dark caps on the worst bars and the diagonal hatch entirely. Every bar is now ONE calm colour, the home green #3da35a (--green-dot, the .home-mark-dot green), which reads cleaner against white than the pale lime; bars stay thin with rounded 3px tops between the existing top+bottom hairlines; the last bar keeps .is-now for the lime 'Now' marker (fill stays the one green). Removed the per-bar .is-sat/.is-mod/.is-poor/.is-worst classes from the chart markup and the matching .vl-chart .is-* CSS rules. The AQI ramp tokens (--aqi-good/-sat/-mod/-poor/-worst) are KEPT because the pollutant .vl-bar-* rows and .vl-dot-* still use them. Chart caption rewritten factual (low 84 Satisfactory / high 214 Very Poor / now 168 Moderate) with NO em dash and NO 'warmer, darker and capped bars are worse' severity-by-colour language. (2) Added TWO new static mock sections to the left column as .vl-section siblings (so they inherit the shipped 44px/24px hairline rhythm): 'Solar – Building Insights' (Max panels 38, Sunshine 1,642 hrs/yr, Roof area 74 m2, Yearly energy 13,900 kWh) and 'Pollen' (Grass index 3 Moderate, Tree index 4 High, Weed index 2 Low). Both reuse the existing .vl-prow label/track/bar/value/category row pattern; both reference the APIs the page already names in src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx (solar.googleapis.com/v1/buildingInsights:findClosest, pollen.googleapis.com/v1/forecast:lookup); plausible static Delhi sample data, NO API call. Twins byte-identical (HTML 7344c970...); PNG pairs byte-identical (1280 660e543c..., 390 5c464724...); shots regenerated with --shots.
